main_text.p: ea obsessos vis hostium & penuria urgebat: consumptisque omnibus quae mandi poterant, fames invaluerat. Ita defessis intus Ierem. 39.inedia defensoribus opidum captum incensumque. Rex, ut propheta dixerat, effosis oculis, Captivi-tasBabyloniam translatus: Hieremias Babylonica.misericordia hostili carcere exemptus. Cum eum Nabuzardan princeps regius, captivum cum caeteris duceret, delata sibi optione ab eo, utrum in solo patrio deferto defolatoque subsistere, an secum abire in summis honoribus vellet, residere in patria maluit. Nabuchodonosor abducto populo, reliquis, quos belli conditio vel praedae fastidium a reliquosreliquos a victoribus fecerat, forte te-linqui.Godolian ejusdem gentis Sig. reli-praepofuit, absque ullo insigni regio, aut quias. Gis.imperii nomine: quia praeesse paucis & calamitosis, nulla dignitas erat.

page.notes: The page number "ij" is probably "ii" with a j-form second letter; the left-margin notes are partly cut and some are uncertain ("quias. Gis.", "forte te-linqui."). The word "deferto" is a doubtful reading. The "Captivi-" and "Babylonica" notes are split across lines. The text may include several printed errors; the transcription keeps the printed spelling where legible.
